testedSource: Uncommitted adapter and test identified by content SHA-256; HEAD remains the baseline.
behavior: The commit input accepts readonly reason?: string. Non-empty strings are trimmed and appended as reason to the commit POST. Missing, empty and whitespace-only values leave the five-field JSON byte-identical. The adapter does not log, retain, mutate the input, or copy its private reason into outcomes; preview serialization is unchanged.
lineCountMethod: git diff --numstat against baseline for tracked files; ReadAllLines for total file lines; untracked receipts are additions. Product and test counts are separate.
